Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team found the latency and cost breakouts really compelling. We’re running a tight head-to-head with two other vendors next week and want to make sure our engineering bench can run a few longer scenarios.

We have three asks:
- A top-up of pilot credits (approx 150k tokens) to cover longer sequence tests and embeddings at scale.
- A two-week extension on the sandbox window (from Nov 10 -> Nov 24) to accommodate our data refresh.
- A short SOW template and any guardrails for data retention we should share with security.

If you can confirm by EOD Wednesday we’ll lock Redwood into our mutual action plan and push hardware tests to next Tuesday. We’re also asking for a written note we can show procurement that this is a one-time bake-off credit.

Appreciate the help — Alicia

Alicia Turner

ClearHealth Analytics
